announcements_delete_hint: Removes announcements from channels after a while to keep busy channels clean. 5 seconds unless you change it. DMs are never deleted.
announcements_dm_subtitle: Members who haven't chosen get their unlocks in DMs too.
announcements_image_subtitle: Design it in the Cards tab. Custom messages place it with %achievement.image%.
announcements_log_hint: Where unlocks go when the announce mode uses a log channel.
announcements_log_needed: Pick a channel, or nothing gets announced.
announcements_log_problem: The bot can't post or embed links there.
announcements_mention_subtitle: Ping members in unlock messages unless they turn it off.
announcements_message_hint: Leave it empty for the default embed in the grade's color. When several unlock at once, the placeholders use the best one and %achievement.list% lists them all.
announcements_message_placeholder: Click to write a custom unlock message, or leave it for the default
announcements_message_preview_descriptio: Sent when a member unlocks achievements
announcements_mode_0_text: The log channel when one is set, otherwise the channel it happened in.
announcements_mode_1_text: In the channel the member was active in, falling back to the log channel.
announcements_mode_2_text: Only in the log channel. Nothing is sent without one.
announcements_mode_3_text: Only in members' DMs, for those who allow it.
announcements_mode_4_text: Achievements unlock quietly with no message.
announcements_quiet_hint: Members still earn achievements in these channels. The unlock is posted in the log channel instead, or not at all when there isn't one.
announcements_quiet_label: Keep unlocks out of some channels
announcements_require_send_subtitle: Skips channels the member can't send messages in, such as a read only channel they reacted in. The log channel is never skipped.
announcements_require_send_title: Only post where the member can talk
announcements_where_hint: Several unlocks at once share one message. Members can turn messages, mentions, and DMs off for themselves.
card_designer_edit_text_hint: Click text on the card to type over it, or drag it to move it.
card_designer_error_max_elements: A card holds at most {max} elements.
card_designer_leave_message: Changes to this design since the last save are lost.
card_designer_palette_hint: The dashboard's own card look, tinted by the server icon's colors.
card_designer_palette_wash_hint: Tints the background with the server icon's colors
card_designer_shortcuts_hint: Arrows nudge, Shift moves 10. Delete removes, Ctrl or Cmd with D duplicates.
card_designer_shrink_to_text_hint: Sits at the alignment inside its box
card_designer_snap: Snap to 4px (hold Alt to place freely)
card_designer_start_over: Start over from the built in design
card_designer_start_over_message: Every change in this design is replaced. You can undo this until you leave the designer.
card_designer_start_over_title: Start over from the built in design?
card_helpers_kind_icon_hint: The achievement's icon on a tile
card_helpers_kind_member_hint: The member's name and the server
card_helpers_kind_more_hint: "+2 more" when several unlock at once
card_helpers_kind_progress_hint: Shown on locked achievements with a goal
card_image_delete_message: Every design using it loses the image.
card_text_default_hint: Leave it empty to keep the default. Emoji and icons show up in the preview.
cards_tab_built_in_subtitle: Mewdeko's design in your server's colors.
cards_tab_delete_message: Categories and achievements using it go back to the server default. If it is the default, the built in design takes over.
cards_tab_error_assign: Couldn't change which design that uses.
cards_tab_error_max_designs: A server keeps at most {max} designs. Delete one first.
cards_tab_intro: The image attached to unlock messages and shown by achview. Every achievement uses the default, {name}, unless its category or itself picks another design.
cards_tab_overrides_hint: Optional. Give a whole category or a single achievement its own design. An achievement's own design wins over its category's.
categories_delete_message_none: It has no achievements in it.
categories_delete_message_one: Its {count} achievement moves to the Server category. Nobody loses anything.
categories_delete_message_other: Its {count} achievements move to the Server category. Nobody loses anything.
categories_new_hint: Group your own achievements, like Events, Seasons, or Lore. {used} of {max} used.
categories_new_icon_label: Pick an icon for the new category
categories_order_hint: Members see categories in this order everywhere. Deactivating one stops new unlocks in it; anything already earned stays.
categories_prestige_subtitle: Bonus achievements for unlocking every achievement in a category.
editor_active_subtitle_existing: Deactivating it keeps it for everyone who already unlocked it.
editor_active_subtitle_new: Members can start earning it as soon as it's saved.
editor_blocker_emoji: Pick the emoji to watch for.
editor_blocker_goal: Set a goal of at least 1.
editor_blocker_name_length: Names can be {max} characters at most.
editor_blocker_phrase: Add the phrase to watch for.
editor_blocker_role: The bot can't give out that role. Move its highest role above it.
editor_delete_message_one: {count} member unlocked it and loses it, along with its points.
editor_delete_message_other: {count} members unlocked it and lose it, along with its points.
editor_description_hint: Leave blank to describe the goal automatically.
editor_discard_message: Your edits to this achievement haven't been saved.
editor_global_notice: Global achievements are earned across every server and can't be changed per server.
editor_icon_hint: Shown in its image, here, and in the apps. Pick an icon, one of the server's emojis, or an image.
editor_manual_hint: Give it from the Members tab or with the achgrant command.
editor_phrase_hint: Matched anywhere in a message, ignoring case.
editor_preview_hint: Attached to unlock messages while unlock images are on. Members can also show it with the achview command.
editor_reset_message: Its name, description, icon, points, and rewards go back to how the bot ships them, and it becomes active again.
editor_role_problem: The bot can't give out that role.
editor_secret_subtitle: Shown as a hidden achievement until someone finds it.
editor_trigger_keyword_text: Unlocks when a message contains the phrase.
editor_trigger_manual_text: Only given with the grant command or from Members.
editor_trigger_metric_text: Messages, voice hours, invites, level, and more.
editor_trigger_reaction_text: Unlocks the first time they react with it.
icon_delete_message: Achievements and categories using it go back to their default icon.
icon_error_https: Image links have to start with https://.
icon_error_size: Images have to be under 4 MB.
icon_no_emojis: This server has no emojis of its own.
icon_search_placeholder: Search icons, like trophy or star
icon_upload_prompt: Upload an image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP, under 4 MB)
library_created_message: Made {name}. Members who already qualify get it quietly within a few minutes.
library_empty_custom_text: Make your own: hit a number, say a phrase, react with an emoji, or something staff hand out by hand.
members_pick_prompt: Pick a member to see their progress, give achievements, or take them away.
members_reset_message: Every achievement they have here is cleared. Their tracked activity stays, so anything they still qualify for comes back quietly.
members_revoke_message: They lose its points. If it unlocks from activity they still qualify for, it comes back quietly later.
overview_earning_text: Members unlock achievements, earn badges, and climb ranks as they take part.
overview_paused_text: Turn them on and members who already qualify get their achievements quietly, without a flood of messages.
overview_recent_empty: Nothing yet. Unlocks show up here as they happen.
overview_source_commands_off: Command achievements need command stats, which this server opted out of.
overview_source_messages_off: Message achievements can't track until message counting is on.
overview_source_reputation_off: Reputation achievements need the reputation system.
overview_source_unneeded: Not tracking, and no active achievement needs it.
overview_source_voice_off: Voice hours and channels need voice tracking in Server Stats.
overview_source_xp_off: Level achievements need XP gain turned on.
overview_sources_hint: Achievements read numbers other features already track. Anything not tracking means some achievements can't move.
overview_started_message: Members can now earn achievements. Those who already qualify get theirs quietly over the next few minutes.
page_paused_notice: Earning is paused in this server, so nothing unlocks yet. You can still set everything up first.
page_subtitle: Milestones, badges, and ranks members earn by taking part
settings_exclude_hint: Members with these roles earn nothing, and activity in these channels doesn't count. Bots never earn.
settings_recheck_hint: Useful after turning on a data source. Anything members already qualify for unlocks quietly.
settings_recheck_started: Checking every member again. Anything they qualify for unlocks quietly in the next few minutes.
settings_reset_all_hint: Clears all unlocks and points in this server. Settings and your own achievements stay.
settings_reset_message: Every member loses every achievement and point in this server. Tracked activity stays, so anything still qualified for comes back quietly. This can't be undone.
settings_reveal_hint: Members see the names and goals of secret achievements before unlocking them.
settings_xp_per_point_hint: Achievement ranks and XP levels are separate. Set this to have every unlock also pay XP: a Gold unlock is 50 points, so 2 here gives 100 XP. 0 turns it off.
